en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Umar Bin Abdul Aziz, from Is’haq Bin Abdul Aziz, and Jameel, and Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘From what Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> taught Fatima<sup>asws</sup> is that he<sup>saww</sup> said to her<sup>asws</sup>: ‘O Fatima<sup>asws</sup>! The one who was a believer in Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and the Last Day, so let him be benevolent with his guest’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from ‘Umar ibn ‘Abd al-’Aziz from Ishaq ibn ‘Abd al-’Aziz and Jamil and Zurarah who have said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has stated this Hadith.

‘Of the matters that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, taught to Fatimah, ‘Alayha al-Salam, was his saying, “O Fatimah, whoever believes in Allah and in the Day of Judgment, he must honor his guest.’””
